content.text: Any chance you could get me a high res image of Jay Allen?

And if you have one, would there be any issues with copyright for us to make a graphic for social? Word on the street he’s not doing well. (There’s a few mentions on twitter, but my boss told me to keep it confidential, but I feel like it is what it is)
Let me ask I’ll text you when I’m home
Ok. it’s a weird situation bc he hasn’t been with us that long, but also if something happens and we don’t address it, that looks terrible
Do you cover anything for caravan?
I am just volunteering at the Kids Club Rally today bc we’re always short staffed for that and it’s the main event run by my team
Ok I’m home. Before I ask, can you guys put a Free Press credit on the graphic or no?
I’m sure they’ll bring that up
Probably not. I figured that would be an issue
I asked, so I’ll let you know, either way
Yeah, they’re going to need a credit
